entities.summary: Vjosa Osmani-Sadriu is a Kosovar Albanian jurist and politician serving since April 2021 as President of Kosovo, having previously served as acting president from November 2020 to March 2021. She also served as Speaker of the Assembly of Kosovo from 2020 to 2021.
